<title level="1" right="Spell 2" pfs="Standard">
[Waterproof](/Spells.aspx?ID=1397)
<actions string="Two Actions" />
</title>

<traits>
<trait label="Concentrate" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=32" />
<trait label="Manipulate" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=104" />
<trait label="Water" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=165" />
</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [Rage of Elements](/Sources.aspx?ID=205) pg. 175

**Traditions**
[Arcane](/SpellLists.aspx?Tradition=1), [Primal](/SpellLists.aspx?Tradition=4)

<row gap="medium">

 

</row>

<row gap="medium">
**Range** touch

**Target** 1 object up to 10 Bulk
</row>

<row gap="medium">

**Duration** 1 hour
</row>

</column>

---

You prevent the target item from taking on water or becoming wet for the duration of the spell. The hydrophobic properties of the spell also grant resistance 10 to acid and a +2 bonus to saves and DCs against damaging effects with the [water](/Traits.aspx?ID=165) or [acid](/Traits.aspx?ID=3) traits.

---
**Heightened (4th)** The duration is 1 day.

**Heightened (8th)** The duration is unlimited.
name: Waterproof
